name: agent-container-claude
description: Claude Code CLI only, installed into the claude image. `allowScripts` is load-bearing: @anthropic-ai/claude-code needs its postinstall (node install.cjs) to hard-link the real binary over the ~1 kB placeholder in the npm tarball. The approval is version-pinned on purpose — a version bump brings the npm 11 warning back until this entry is updated.
